The Challenge

Healthcare Supply Chains are Inefficient and Costly

$30B

Wasted annually in the U.S. healthcare supply chain due to overstock, expired products, and procurement inefficiencies.

40%

Of hospitals lack visibility into their supply chain costs — making it impossible to identify savings opportunities.

25%

Of medical supplies expire before use — a direct waste of resources that could be avoided with better inventory management.

Transform Your Supply Chain with Data

Healthcare supply chains are among the most complex and costly in any industry. Yet most organizations lack the visibility needed to identify and capture savings opportunities. Overstocking, expiring products, and supplier pricing variations drive unnecessary expense without improving patient care.

Our Healthcare Supply Chain & Inventory Analytics service provides end‑to‑end visibility into your supply chain — from procurement to consumption. We analyze spend, inventory, supplier performance, and utilization to identify savings opportunities and drive operational efficiency.

We help you optimize inventory levels, reduce waste, consolidate suppliers, and negotiate better contracts. Our predictive analytics forecast demand and guide procurement planning, ensuring that critical supplies are always available when needed — without excess.

Achieve measurable cost reduction, improve operational efficiency, and enhance patient safety through better supply chain management.

Supply Chain Analytics

Our Approach

Data Integration & Consolidation

We connect to your ERP, inventory management systems, procurement platforms, and supplier databases. We consolidate item master data, purchase orders, invoices, and consumption records into a unified analytics layer.

Inventory Optimization & Par Level Analysis

We analyze usage patterns, lead times, and variability to recommend optimal inventory levels. We identify slow‑moving, expired, and overstocked items — and quantify the cost of carrying excess inventory.

Supplier Performance & Value Analysis

We evaluate suppliers on cost, quality, reliability, and responsiveness. We identify opportunities for consolidation, renegotiation, and strategic sourcing. We benchmark pricing against market averages.

Spend Analytics & Waste Reduction

We analyze spend across categories, departments, and product lines. We identify variation in pricing, utilization, and waste — and recommend interventions that reduce cost without compromising care.

Demand Forecasting & Procurement Planning

We forecast demand for supplies based on historical utilization, seasonal patterns, and clinical trends. We optimize procurement schedules and order quantities to minimize stockouts and overstock.

Continuous Monitoring & Improvement

We provide real‑time dashboards that track inventory turns, fill rates, and cost savings. We alert you to potential shortages, price increases, and compliance issues.

What We Deliver

Supply Chain Performance Dashboard

Real‑time visibility into inventory levels, fill rates, supplier performance, and cost metrics across all departments.

Inventory Optimization Recommendations

Actionable guidance on par levels, reorder points, and order quantities. Eliminate excess and reduce waste.

Supplier Scorecards & Performance Reports

Comprehensive evaluation of supplier cost, quality, delivery, and compliance. Identify top performers and opportunities.

Spend & Waste Analysis Report

Quantified analysis of spend by category, variation, and waste. Prioritized opportunities for cost reduction.

Demand Forecast & Procurement Plan

Predictive demand forecasts with optimized procurement schedules to minimize cost and ensure availability.

Alerting & Compliance Monitoring

Automated alerts for stock‑outs, recalls, price changes, and compliance issues.

Core Capabilities

Real‑Time Inventory Dashboard

View inventory levels, turnover rates, and stock‑out risks across all departments and locations. Identify items approaching expiry.

Supplier Scorecards

Compare suppliers on cost, quality, delivery, and compliance. Automate vendor performance tracking.

Spend Categorization & Variability Analysis

Classify spend by category, department, and product. Highlight unwarranted price variation and utilization differences.

Demand Forecasting Engine

Predict demand for each item using machine learning, incorporating seasonality, trends, and external factors.

Shortage & Recall Alerts

Receive alerts when inventory falls below safety stock levels or when suppliers issue recalls.

Value Analysis & Standardization

Identify opportunities to standardize items across departments, reduce variation, and negotiate volume discounts.
